evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%.
